title: Check #4334's sharp right-vector threshold over F4, F8, F9, F16, F25, F27: no common pivot, three-factor word, delta = 2; F4 two-factor exhaustive (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/right-vector-extension-fields/`. It checks #4334 (ToikY) over six non-prime fields.

#4334 proves a sharp component threshold for invertible right-vector targets over `K^k`, for every finite field `F_q`: cost at most 2 when `k ≤ q`, and examples with cost 3 and `δ = 2` when `k ≥ q+1`. The sharp example uses a quadratic extension. Its software witnesses cover only prime fields; the README says it does not "claim an extension-field software census".

**Claim type: an independent finite check. No new κ.**

## Result

For `F_4`, `F_8`, `F_9`, `F_16`, `F_25` and `F_27`, with #4334's target of `q+1` multiplication components:

- every input line is sent onto every line of `P¹(K)` exactly once;
- there is **no common pivot** over all `(q+1)²` pairs, so the cost exceeds 2;
- #4334's Section 3 three-factor word reproduces every component, so the cost is 3;
- `δ = 2`, by brute force over every free `T ∈ GL_2(K)`;
- 300 random `k = q` targets all have a common pivot.

**F4 without the criterion.** An exhaustive search over every free map, right-vector pair and left vector finds **no two-paid-factor word**. The same search finds one when a component is dropped (`k = q`), which is the control.

## Evidence

- Standard library only; runs in about 90 seconds.
- `F_(p^k)` arithmetic and the irreducible quadratic are built and checked here. Nothing is imported from #4334.

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/right-vector-extension-fields --check-only
  PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/right-vector-extension-fields
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/right-vector-extension-fields outcome=completed
```

Head: `3a54499c0967ff4cf17214449b20fb080087e5a3`.

## Not covered

- The all-field proof itself, which this corroborates and does not replace.
- Singular targets and general commutative algebras.
- Any caller.

## Task and overlap

- Card: `bit-new-register-model`, #4334's card; refined, priority revision 7.
- Base: canonical main `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`.
- #4334 has no comments.

## Credit

The theorem, construction and word are ToikY's (#4334), answering Nick Petalas's #4276 and building on Wentao Li's #4099. Prepared by Ryanson Jonathan with substantial Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) assistance. Apache-2.0.
